about_the_game:
A disillusioned young man, shackled by the mediocrity of adulthood, unexpectedly time-warps back to his student years, awakening the enigmatic ​Temporal Romance Strategy System. Guided by his roguish wingman Tong Jincheng, he navigates parallel timelines spanning naive campus days and cutthroat corporate warfare, leveraging future memories to rewrite destinies.

Seven women become entangled in his chrono-disrupted journey – the childhood friend harboring silent devotion, the college sweetheart turned industry rival, the protegee who outgrows her mentor. Witness their metamorphosis: from chalk-dusted classrooms to glass-walled boardrooms, from shared e-bike commutes to the roar of AMG engines.

As temporal ripples amplify every choice, can this accidental time architect balance equations of ambition and affection? The system demands a verdict: corporate empire or love's singularity?
